{{Short description|Statistical survey}}
{{No footnotes|date=November 2019}}
A '''time-use survey''' is a statistical survey which aims to report data on how, on average, people spend their time. 

== Objectives ==

The objective of the Time-Use survey is to identify, classify and quantify the main types of activity that people engage in during a definitive time period, e.g. a year, a month, etc. Many{{quantify|date=November 2014}} surveys are used for calculation of [[unpaid work]] done by women as well as men in particular locality.{{cn|date=November 2014}}
